audience: finance and operations teams that extract fields from invoices and receipts with Typless

useCases.title: Extract the fields of one document
useCases.text: Send one PDF, JPG, PNG, TIFF or BMP up to 10 MB as base64. Get the extracted fields in the same call. The document type must exist in your Typless account.

useCases.title: Start an extraction for a larger file
useCases.text: Start an extraction from base64 content, or from a public https link of up to 35 MiB. Read the result later with its extraction id.

useCases.title: Collect finished extractions
useCases.text: List the extractions that finished in the last 2 days and that you have not read yet. Reading a result removes its id from this list.

useCases.title: Check the status of one extraction
useCases.text: Read the status of one extraction: in progress, success, error or expired. Results are deleted 48 hours after processing finishes.
